# External Data Sources
## Protein Classification Data and Persistence Landscapes
- Source: [Benjamin et al. (2023)](https://github.com/katherine-benjamin/ph-knotted-proteins)
- Files: `trefoil_list.csv`, landscapes of protein dataset
- License: [MIT License]
- Retrieved: 2025-02-12

For the 2026 revision audit, the direct degree-one `interpolated_x1` and `interpolated_x6` landscape cohorts and `trefoil_list.csv` were recovered from source commit `6262a2bf760155a9a3aad2672d1e51f07a01dfe9` on 2026-09-22. Raw landscapes are kept under the ignored `data/external/landscapes/` directory. Per-file checksums and the cohort/label reconciliation are recorded in the project-level `results/input-audit/2026-09-22/` directory.
